title: Income Tax Act
verified_how: Register index entry 'Income Tax Act', consolidation date November 23, 2023. Cover page prints 'INCOME TAX ACT / RSNWT 1988,c.I-1' (French: 'LOI DE L'IMPOT SUR LE REVENU / LRTN-O 1988, ch. I-1'), with the amendment chain beginning SNWT 1988,c.19(Supp.) and running forward, each with its in-force date. Standard office-consolidation notice; not marked repealed. Administering department per the October 13, 2025 table: Finance.
notes: This is the territorial income tax Act, named as required. NWT personal income tax is levied under it and collected by the Canada Revenue Agency under a federal-territorial collection agreement; the register separately lists an Income Tax Collection Agreement Questions Act for disputes about that agreement. The federal Income Tax Act, R.S.C. 1985, c. 1 (5th Supp.) governs the computation of income and source withholding itself. The NWT also levies a payroll tax on remuneration earned in the territory under the Payroll Tax Act, listed separately on the same register (consolidation date November 23, 2023) - relevant to withholding, but not chosen as the principal Act for this topic.
